rejected.title: Paid administrator role
rejected.reason: The official paid notice says the administrator ensures resources are used efficiently and sustainably, but specifies no concrete chore, inputs, or repeatable output. With no attached building reference or task detail, a narrow experiment and its five ratings would require invented duties; rejected as insufficient task evidence.

steps.message: The only selected professional-services lead is a broad administrator vacancy without a concrete task. Rejected for insufficient task evidence; no demand-backed idea can be honestly scored or proposed from this batch.
